description.en: Fresh, colorful React component collection expanding the shadcn ecosystem.
description.zh: 色彩鲜明活泼的 React 组件库，作为 shadcn 生态的视觉风格扩展。

content.en: Watermelon UI injects vibrant energy and bold color schemes into the shadcn ecosystem. Developed for creatives who want their interfaces to break away from monochromatic grayscale, Watermelon UI offers tactile colorful buttons, candy badges, and playful tooltips.
content.zh: Watermelon UI 为略显单调的黑白灰 shadcn 生态注入了鲜活明亮的色彩张力。它针对追求视觉差异化的独立创作者量身定制，包含高饱和度触觉按钮、糖果色标签与灵动气泡提示，全面兼容 shadcn 的组件解耦结构。
